name: kube-state-metrics Kubernetes Object Monitoring
free_limit: Apache-2.0 open-source Kubernetes add-on exporting deployment, node, pod and other Kubernetes API object state metrics to a Prometheus-compatible endpoint, with no software license fee.
watch_out: Requires your own Kubernetes cluster and separate metrics scraper/storage; it reports API object state, not full application tracing or node/container resource telemetry. Compute, storage and Prometheus infrastructure are not included.
